SELECT `호관`, 
       MAX(`IP가_부여된_단말기_수`) AS `BUILDING_IP_COUNTS_단말기_개수`,
       SUM(`단말기_개수`) AS `ROOM_IP_COUNTS_단말기_개数_합`
FROM `BUILDING_IP_COUNTS`
LEFT JOIN `ROOM_IP_COUNTS` 
  ON `호관` = LEFT(`사용호실`, 1)
GROUP BY `호관`
ORDER BY `호관`;
